items.title: S&P upgrades KLA to ’A’ as AI chip demand bolsters scale and balance sheet
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings raised its issuer credit and unsecured debt ratings on KLA Corporation (NASDAQ:KLAC) to 'A' from 'A-', citing accelerating operational scale from artificial intelligence infrastructure alongside disciplined balance-sheet management. The agency paired the upgrade with a stable outlook, reflecting expectations that the semiconductor equipment specialist will keep adjusted leverage well beneath 1.5x over the medium term.

items.title: S&P cuts Salesforce to ’A’ on rising acquisition debt and buybacks
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings downgraded Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM) to 'A' from 'A+', pointing to an increasingly aggressive capital allocation strategy characterized by debt-funded shareholder returns and large-scale acquisitions. The ratings agency highlighted that recent dealmaking, alongside a $25 billion debt-financed share repurchase program, has pushed pro forma net debt-to-EBITDA above its previous 2x downgrade threshold.

items.title: Prosegur Compania De Seguridad SA (STU:PRHA) (Q3 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Revenue Growth ...
items.summary: Prosegur Compania De Seguridad SA (STU:PRHA) posted 7.5% revenue growth and improved free cash flow in Q3 2026, but EBITDA slipped 1.7% as Argentina headwinds and business mix weighed on margins.
